description:
After dying at the height of her youth while chasing her dream of becoming a singer, Jung Soo-yi has wandered the afterlife for twenty-five years. One day, she’s suddenly pulled into the body of Im Yu-na, a washed-up B-list celebrity who has just ended her own life. 

Could this be heaven’s way of granting her a second chance to fulfill the dream she never achieved? 

But Yu-na’s life is a complete mess. A mother who sees her only as a cash machine, an agency CEO who treats her like a puppet, and the public’s scornful gaze calling her a “brainless celebrity.” Too bad for them, they picked the wrong person to mess with. 

“I’m Jung Soo-yi, the heavenly voice who once ruled Itaewon’s King Club, 007!” 

Then appears Kang Tae-hoon, CEO of Hwaja Entertainment and president of JC Group. After meeting Soo-yi’s piercing gaze, he says, “With eyes like that… you can do anything.” 

On a stage where past regrets, present despair, and future ambition collide, her second act begins.
